prompt: A multi-file refactor starts renaming a shared helper in ways that will break two other files it hasn't touched yet. Which posture catches it, and when?

options.label: Pairing (watching each step)
options.content: You see the rename happen on step 2 of 6, before the other files are touched. One correction, cheap to make, task continues cleanly. Cost: you spent attention on all 6 steps, not just this one.

options.label: Delegating (checking the final result)
options.content: You find out on review, after all 6 steps ran - two files are now broken, and untangling which change depended on which requires reading the whole diff, not just the last step. Cost: much less attention while it ran, but a bigger cleanup once you look.
